vibe: Quiet, confident, gallery-like, earthy/warm minimal, structural, place-making philosophy. Heavily leans on negative space, editorial typography, and high-end architectural imagery. Avoids generic SaaS looks.

styles.overline: font-sans tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-stone-500 text-xs md:text-sm

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow architectural photography to breathe.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento-style grids for portfolio. Asymmetry preferred. Avoid perfect symmetry.
layout_and_spacing.hero_overlay: bg-stone-900/30 (Gradient overlay from bottom to top for text readability)

components.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-none). 1px solid border. hover:bg-stone-800 hover:text-white transition-all duration-300 ease-out
components.cards: Cardless design for the frontend. Use flat images with text underneath. For admin, use simple flat white boxes with border-stone-200 and shadow-sm.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults customized to rounded-none, border-stone-300, focus:border-stone-900 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-stone-900
components.navigation: Crystal glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-stone-200. Sticky top. Nav links in font-sans.
components.admin_dashboard: Dense, utilitarian. Use Lucide icons. High contrast sidebar (dark) with light content area. Use Shadcn tables, dialogs, and forms. Strictly functional.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Images subtly scale up (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden containers.
interactions_and_motion.scroll: Staggered fade-up entrances for text and images using Framer Motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts in your CSS/HTML: Cormorant Garamond, Outfit, and Manrope.
For the admin panel and scheduling system, implement Shadcn UI components (forms, inputs, date pickers, dialogs).
Strip generic border-radius from Shadcn components to make them feel more architectural (e.g. use rounded-none).
The frontend must feel like a high-end editorial magazine with large imagery and elegant typography. The admin panel must feel like a crisp, professional productivity tool.
Do not use generic Inter font. Ensure typography mapping is exact as specified.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure generous padding/margins on the marketing pages to match the gallery-like aesthetic.
